# both nextest attempts on windows-2022 in at least one run (scratch runs

# Linux. The git_enrichment tests are intermittent: concurrent_turns passed in
# 42626867876 and failed in the other two; startup_prewarm failed in
# 42626867876 and passed in 42634961756.
# Format: <cargo package> <exact nextest test name> #<issue>
# (a test at the top of its own binary, tests/<binary>.rs, has no module path)

# longer exists fails .github/scripts/test_windows_integration_known_failures.py.
